content.rendered:
• FAST TREATMENTS: Use for just 30 mins every other day, completely portable for an on the go lifestyle.
  • FDA-CLEARED: Peace of mind knowing your Kiierr Laser Cap is safe & effective.
  • DOCTOR RECOMMENDED: Kiierr MD Laser Caps are loved by physicians and used in doctor’s offices and hair restoration clinics across the USA.
  • 7-MONTH GROWTH GUARANTEE: With over 93% success rate in clinical studies, what are you waiting for? If you do not receive thicker, fuller hair after 7 months, you may send it back for a refund (see return policy for details).

Features of the Kiierr MD and MD Elite Laser Hair Caps:

  • 272 Medical Grade Laser Diodes
  • 30 Minute Auto-Timed Sessions
  • Upgraded Safety Features
  • Portable Upgraded Battery Pack

The MD Elite Laser Cap provides 25% More Coverage & Size for Maximum Results.https://kiierr.com/wp-admin/media-upload.php?post_id=15827&type=image&TB_iframe=1

Kiierr MD/MD Elite Complete System Bundle Includes:

  • 272 Diode MD or MD Elite – Laser Helmet
  • Plain Black Ball Cap (wear your laser cap anywhere)
  • Wall Charger, USB Cord & Power Pack
  • User Manual & FAQ’s Guide
  • Kiierr Hair Growth Bundle (shampoo, conditioner & vitamins) 
  • FREE Biotin Gummies for Hair Growth $34.99 value
  • FREE Laser Cap Carrying Case $49.99 value
  • FREE 3 year Product Extended Warranty $89.99 value

Hair loss can be effectively treated by promoting new hair growth and revitalizing weak hair follicles. Take the first step towards reversing hair loss today with the Kiierr MD Elite laser hair cap! Growing thicker, healthier hair is not difficult anymore, thanks to Kiierr laser hair cap and hair growth products. What’s more, the effortless yet effective approach with which we tackle thinning hair means that it works even while you’re watching TV, taking a walk, or reading a book. Therefore, you can keep the cap on, no matter what activity you’re busy with – including sleeping (it automatically turns off when you sleep) – and rest assured that the hair growth therapy is in progress!

The Science Behind LLLT & the Kiierr MD Elite Laser Hair Cap

The science behind the LLLT technology is that by virtue of a process called photo-biotherapy, cells absorb the low-level light emitted from the laser, which stimulates their metabolism and protein synthesis. These processes in turn stimulate the hair follicles, thereby promoting hair growth and reducing hair loss.  Scientific studies have proved that the LLLT technology results in thicker and healthier hair. Both the studies and governing certifications have attested to the safety and effectiveness of this technology. Regardless of whether you’ll be using the Kiierr MD Elite laser hair cap as a stand-alone remedy or in combination with topical foams, prescription medications, and hair transplant surgeries, it’s an effective treatment for hair loss. In fact, all Kiierr LLLT devices are FDA-cleared for promotion of hair growth and reduction of hair loss in adults with androgenetic alopecia. With the help of safe, low-level lasers, the MD laser caps energizes hair follicles and spurs new, natural hair growth.  Our Kiierr MD Elite laser cap is the premium version of our state-of-the-art laser caps. Its efficacy in hair recovery is evident by the fact that it’s used in doctors’ offices and hair restoration clinics across the United States. Compared to other laser caps, our MD Elite model has a longer, wider, and deeper base designed to promote thicker hair even on the back and sides of the scalp. It fits up to 24.5”, offering more scalp coverage as it is 25% larger in size than the original. Plus it has an enhanced laser panel with individual diode lasers, making it last longer with a more durable build.
